scorePolicy:
1. 出席與課堂參與：學生需定期出席並積極參與課堂討論與練習
2. 作業與練習：每週程式設計作業與練習，強化物件導向概念
3. 小考：不定期小考，檢驗學生對基礎語法與概念的掌握
4. 期中考試：著重於物件導向程式設計核心概念與程式設計能力
5. 期末考試：綜合性測驗，涵蓋設計模式、程式實作與理論
1. Attendance and Class Participation: Students are required to attend classes regularly and actively participate in discussions and exercises.

2. Assignments and Exercises: Weekly programming assignments and exercises to reinforce object-oriented programming concepts.

3. Quizzes: Occasional quizzes to assess students' mastery of basic syntax and concepts.

4. Midterm Exam: Focuses on core object-oriented programming concepts and programming skills.

5. Final Exam: A comprehensive test covering design patterns, programming practice, and theory.
materials:
《Java 程式設計導論》或《C++ 程式設計》 
ntroduction to Java Programming or C++ Programming (depending on course language)

參考書目
《物件導向分析與設計》, 《設計模式：可復用物件導向軟體的基礎》
Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
consultation: 學生如有課程相關問題，可透過多元管道進行諮詢：可於課堂中直接向授課教師提問，或利用教師辦公時間進行面談；亦可透過電子郵件與教師聯繫，確保問題能獲得即時回覆。Students may consult through various channels: asking questions in class, visiting office hours, and contacting instructors via email.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
remarks: 本課程特別導入人工智慧（AI）元素，讓學生在學習物件導向程式設計的同時，能理解並應用最新技術。課程中將透過範例程式與專案實作，展示如何在程式設計中整合 AI 模型，例如影像辨識、自然語言處理與智慧推薦系統。This course incorporates artificial intelligence (AI) elements, enabling students to understand and apply the latest technologies while learning object-oriented programming. Through example programs and practical projects, the course demonstrates how to integrate AI models, such as image recognition, natural language processing, and intelligent recommendation systems, into programming.
